question: What are the different schools and departments that offer SIS courses? List their school code, school name, department code, department name, the total number of phone numbers, and the most common course level.
pred_sql:
SELECT
  sd.SCHOOL_CODE AS school_code,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  d.DEPARTMENT AS department_code,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  IFNULL(ed.phone_count,0) + IFNULL(md.phone_count,0) AS total_phone_numbers,
  mcc.most_common_course_level
FROM
  (
    -- derive one row per department that offers SIS courses
    SELECT DEPARTMENT, DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM sis_course_description
    GROUP BY DEPARTMENT, DEPARTMENT_NAME
  ) d
  LEFT JOIN sis_department sd
    ON d.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  LEFT JOIN (
    -- phone counts from employee_directory keyed by department code/number
    SELECT DEPARTMENT_NUMBER AS dept_code, COUNT(OFFICE_PHONE) AS phone_count
    FROM employee_directory
    WHERE OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND OFFICE_PHONE <> ''
    GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NUMBER
  ) ed
    ON d.DEPARTMENT = ed.dept_code
  LEFT JOIN (
    -- phone counts from mit_student_directory keyed by department
    SELECT DEPARTMENT AS dept_code, COUNT(OFFICE_PHONE) AS phone_count
    FROM mit_student_directory
    WHERE OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND OFFICE_PHONE <> ''
    GROUP BY DEPARTMENT
  ) md
    ON d.DEPARTMENT = md.dept_code
  LEFT JOIN (
    -- most common course level per department (U or G). tie-breaker: higher alphabetical (G > U)
    SELECT COURSE_DEPT AS dept_code,
           SUBSTRING_INDEX(
             GROUP_CONCAT(COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY cnt DESC, COURSE_LEVEL DESC SEPARATOR ','),
             ',', 1
           ) AS most_common_course_level
    FROM (
      SELECT DEPARTMENT AS COURSE_DEPT, COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(*) AS cnt
      FROM sis_course_description
      WHERE COURSE_LEVEL IS NOT NULL AND COURSE_LEVEL <> ''
      GROUP BY DEPARTMENT, COURSE_LEVEL
    ) t
    GROUP BY COURSE_DEPT
  ) mcc
    ON d.DEPARTMENT = mcc.dept_code
ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT

),
-- gather subject offerings in summer with their possible instructor-list fields
offers AS (
  SELECT so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, so.TERM_CODE, so.SUBJECT_ID, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS instr_list
  FROM subject_offered so

  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cc2
  WHERE cc2.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU'
),

instrs AS (

    o.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(o.instr_list, ',', nums.n), ',', -1)) AS instructor_name
